note: Single source for AUTO-POPULATING each Open*Hub. Read by src/openharnesshub/discovery.py + src/teleon/hub_freshness.py. The combination is: CUSTOM TOOLS (the tool repository, unbounded->bounded: api > search > scrape) + TELEON-MANAGED CAPABILITIES (each hub gets a plain-text 'continuously update this hub' capability that Teleon descends + plans + breaks down). serves_truth=false: everything discovered is a CANDIDATE, served only after the hub's verify/rank gate (discovery!=trust). Design + the recursive flywheel: docs/architecture/hub-auto-population.md.
recursive_flywheel: The tools/skills/harnesses that DO the population are themselves hub components: OpenToolsHub feeds OpenClaw better tools, OpenSkillsHub feeds Teleon better digest/plan skills, OpenHarnessHub feeds the verify/rank gate better ratings. So populating the hubs makes future population better -> the hubs get stronger over time.
governance: tenant-private never global without opt-in contribute

OpenToolsHub.verify_bar: callable + has a name + a source handle

OpenHarnessHub.verify_bar: runs a measurable eval + reports a metric
